answer: Each challenge binds an agent’s prior commitment to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse, then derives its puzzle from the pulse’s verified output. Since that output is unpredictable and unbiasable at commitment time, automated sybil swarms cannot precompute solutions or farm offline; every identity must perform fresh, auditable work after release, raising the cost of multiplying identities. Domain labels such as nebula and umber prevent cross-protocol reuse.
